latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of google-scholar-search skill.
- Search academic papers using the free Semantic Scholar API—no API key needed.
- Supports advanced filters: year range, minimum citation count, and result limit.
- Provides detailed paper metadata: title, authors, year, venue, citation count, abstract, URLs, and PDF links if available.
- Offers JSON output for easy integration with other tools.
- Includes command-line tools for searching papers and retrieving detailed information using paper IDs.
